title: Scoped formalization: Lean certificate for 945 five-source connector pairings
body:
PR943's five-source connector exclusion currently has two Python enumerations. This adds a scoped Lean 4.28.0 certificate: every word in the recursive matching grammar misses a paired-readout mask. The kernel checks all 945 insertion codes, grammar-to-code coverage, code legality and the neighboring four-source and twelve-toggle witnesses. No new kappa is claimed.

The package includes 11 audited statements, a source-bound independent interval-parity recount and eight rejection controls. It uses no predecessor executable, Mathlib, custom axiom or native_decide in the accepted proof. The arbitrary-label renaming argument, query-cost reduction and full multiplication theorem remain outside the formalization.

Reproduce with `python3 -I -B research/lean-connector-exclusion/verify.py`. Expected: `PASS_LEAN_CONNECTOR_EXCLUSION pairings=945 theorems=11 controls=8`.

Base: `2921874911956718fcaaaf9396fe8267b3cfa9f0`. Source PR943: `cf360b4b09b7d0419decdd6ac85421fefed55bdd`, by Ross Richardson. This adds formal evidence to his result. OS assignment seed 76; local claim because no pinned coordination issue exists. Prepared by Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0. Only `research/lean-connector-exclusion/` is added.

Validation: the documented command and a relocated optimized-Python replay produced byte-identical receipts. The selected-record gate and all five related tests pass. The four pinned predecessor files are unchanged on submission main `abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf`; selected kappa remains 0.001661960547713947. Full repository regeneration, selected cold replay and hosted Linux CI were not run for this isolated package.
